title: Guillén & Herrero 2006, Polycrystalline growth and recrystallization processes in sputtered ITO thin films (Thin Solid Films 510:260)
notes: Six films in Table 1: 170/350/700 nm ITO as-deposited at room temperature and each annealed in vacuum at 350 °C (20 min). A seventh, 350 nm annealed at 250 °C, is named in the text and Fig. 4; its only number (12 Ω/sq) is in the Fig. 4 legend.
Tvis/Tir are averages over 400-800 nm and 800-1500 nm with the glass substrate discounted; both are acceptable transmittance answers.
Power is given only as a density ('below 2 W/cm2'), so sputtering_power has no gold value; the O2/Ar partial-pressure ratio is not stated as a number.
Substrate temperature is 'room temperature'; the 20-40 °C rise is a measurement on static substrates, recorded as ambiguous.
Deposition time is a range (0-40 min) for the whole thickness series, not per sample; base pressure 1e-4 Pa is not the working pressure.
